summary: Dow Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register 5,410,000 shares of common stock under the 2019 Stock Incentive Plan, covering equity awards assumed or granted in connection with the 2019 spin-off from DowDuPont. The filing is a routine shelf takedown for employee equity compensation, not a special situation. The last closing price was $28.50 as of July 9, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event is involved. This is an ordinary registration of shares for ongoing stock incentive plans, with no transaction terms or board recommendation.
